summary: The change adds Store.archive_payments to payments' store.py and nothing else. The SQL is fixed and parameterized (SEC-1) and the archive table carries no NPI (ENC-1), each backed by a passing exhaustive control test in the head-commit CI run. Ticket, independent code review, security review and approval coverage all meet the change policy, and no ledger evidence or exception is affected. I could not re-run the suite locally (pytest missing), so testing relies on the recorded CI run. Not blocking but worth fixing before the method is called: new payment ids are MAX(id)+1 while approvals and releases of archived payments are kept, so a new payment could reuse an archived id and inherit its approvals; also, the description says unit tests were updated but no tests changed.
